runtime.blender_baseline: 4.0.2 (Ubuntu package; exact build reported by capabilities.json)
runtime.version_policy: Reuse the prepared image and record its sha256 digest for each job.
runtime.network: Docker default networking; bundled tools work without additional downloads

tools.notes: CPU/software rendering. bpy scripts can call checkpoint(stage, summary) to save a packed editable scene. References must be declared job inputs. No model-generation API or pretrained model is included.
Script-defined image processing. Save results under OUTPUT_DIR; checkpoint copies completed output files. Algorithms such as normal-map synthesis must be supplied in the script.
Adapter params: input, output, quality; resize also takes width and height. Python steps can invoke additional installed CLI operations.
Encode outputs MP4 or WebM; numbered input sequences use one %d or %04d token. Python steps can invoke additional installed CLI operations.

uses: export layered KRA/ORA/PSD artwork to raster images
tools.notes: Headless export only. Installing Krita does not provide automated GUI painting, brush interaction, or arbitrary layer editing.

Official SHA-256 pinned release; Vulkan compute on CPU via Mesa lavapipe. params: input (.ptex in a dedicated folder), output (filename prefix), optional maps (required outputs). One Static PBR Material per graph. Blender target exports 2048px PNG/EXR maps; upstream 1.7 --size is not used because it does not affect export resolution. Source folder and relative image dependencies are saved under source/. See docs/MATERIAL_MAKER.md.
